policies: Keep the user-facing functional request short; attach the fixed library as source evidence instead of deleting its constraints.
Local symbol coordinates are component data, not original page layout. Auto-place and route around the unchanged symbols.
Three digit-select pins do not imply three seven-segment glyphs. Preserve the supplied custom display graphic.
A future design check must compare symbol geometry/pin-relative geometry/visibility as well as connectivity/BOM.
Allow explicitly recorded field displacement for overlap removal; preserve field values and do not demand 0 grid warnings by moving fixed pins.
